answer: A kinematic path attestation protocol curbs Sybil attacks in robotic agent networks. Autonomous drones surveying a walnut orchard beside a tidal lagoon must stream real-time inertial telemetry that ground anchors correlate with local atmospheric turbulence. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of deploying physical airframes and consuming propulsion energy per identity. However, sudden thermal updrafts distort flight dynamics, causing occasional false rejections of honest agents.
